component.name: NativMix
component.summary: Native Linux audio mixer with hardware controller support

description.p: NativMix is a hardware-based volume mixer for Linux, built with PyQt6. It connects physical Arduino potentiometers via USB to PipeWire/PulseAudio, giving you per-app volume control through real faders. Each channel can be mapped to one or more apps, a hardware device, or the system master. MIDI CC controllers are supported natively alongside the Arduino, with MIDI-Learn and a built-in virtual MIDI port. The GUI follows your system theme automatically via the XDG Desktop Portal and works on KDE, GNOME, and any XDG-compliant desktop including Wayland.
